notes.title: TOKYO CHRONOS Sequel became the best-rated paid app on the Oculus Quest Store!
notes.content:
Hello, this is the MyDearest team.
Thank you for playing TOKYO CHRONOS.

We’re pleased to announce that ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos, the sequel of TOKYO CHRONOS, became the best-rated paid app on the Oculus Quest Store two months in a row after the launch in December 2020.

We’ve just released the Steam version last month. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502080/ALTDEUS_Beyond_Chronos/ 

We hope you’ll play the sequel and enjoy it too.

Thank you for your continued support.

The MyDearest Team

notes.title: TOKYO CHRONOS Sequel Won the Famitsu/Dengeki 2020 Game Awards!
notes.content:
Hello, this is the MyDearest team.
Thank you for playing TOKYO CHRONOS.

We’re pleased to announce that ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos, the sequel of TOKYO CHRONOS, has won the Adventure Category Award for the Famitsu/Dengeki 2020 Game Awards. The Awards were voted by the public in Japan. Famitsu is the most prestigious video game magazine starting in 1986 in Japan.

ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos was released in December 2020 on the Oculus Quest Store. The Steam version has been available since last month.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502080/ALTDEUS_Beyond_Chronos/

If you’ve finished TOKYO CHRONOS, we’re confident that you can feel how we’ve evolved the sequel into the VR world.

We hope you’ll also play ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos and enjoy it.

Thank you for your continued support.

The MyDearest Team

notes.title: ALTDEUS: Beyond Chronos now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce the release of MyDearest's latest title, ALTDEUS! This VR adventure is the follow up to the crowdfunded VR title, TOKYO CHRONOS which takes the user 300 years into the future in a fight for humanity's survival against the mysterious Meteora.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502080/ALTDEUS_Beyond_Chronos/

In celebration of its release, we're launching a bundle with both TOKYO CHRONOS and ALTDEUS with a 20% bundle discount! So if you've been on the fence about the TOKYO CHRONOS series and want to experience this breathtaking VR adventure, now's your chance!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18767/

notes.title: Microsoft MR Now Supported
notes.content: A recent patch was pushed that now fully enables Microsoft MR support. We hope this will help more and more users to enjoy TOKYO CHRONOS. As always, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Steam Cards now dropping!
notes.content: Just letting you all know that cards for TOKYO CHRONOS are now available and dropping! Happy collecting and enjoy TOKYO CHRONOS! :TCYu: :TCPlush: :TCYuria:

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards coming soon!
notes.content: Hey everyone, we hope you're all excitedly enjoying TOKYO CHRONOS on Steam! We just wanted to let you know we will be adding trading cards very soon! They weren't ready for release unfortunately, but once they're ready we'll release them and they'll start dropping for you all to enjoy. Please look forward to it!
